presets.name: compact
presets.label: Compact
presets.description: Smaller dock icons and tighter spacing/padding/rounding — the same keys the Nexus steppers expose.

presets.name: minimal
presets.label: Minimal
presets.description: Issue #120's own example direction: smaller bar and dock, lower rounding, faster animations, badges and previews off.

presets.name: gaming
presets.label: Gaming
presets.description: Snappier shell, no blur/transparency compositing, no popup notifications. (Game Mode itself is a service toggle, not a shell.json scalar — this bundle is the config-side reduction only.)

presets.name: battery-saver
presets.label: Battery saver
presets.description: Reduce compositing and background work: blur, ambient glow and wallpaper recolour off, animations fast.

presets.name: macos-like
presets.label: More like macOS
presets.description: Always-visible bottom dock with larger icons, rounder corners, roomier spacing and badges on — the keys the shipped controls already expose.

explain_rules.answer: Blur is enabled because transparency is currently active and appearance.blur is on — the blur regions gate on both ({cite}).
Blur is ON but has no effect, because transparency is currently disabled — the blur regions gate on transparency.enabled && blur together ({cite}).

explain_rules.when: appearance.transparency.enabled == true and utilities.gameMode.disableShellTransparency == true and _gamemode == true
explain_rules.answer: Transparency is configured ON but is currently suppressed, because Game Mode is active with 'disable shell transparency' set — the colour service gates on that pair ({cite}).
Surfaces look less transparent than the configured base opacity {appearance.transparency.base}, because light mode trims the base by 0.1 ({cite}).
Surfaces are fully opaque and pure black because Pitch Black (bezel mode) is active — it forces opacity 1 ({cite1}) and #000000 surfaces ({cite2}).
The overview blur setting is ON but has no effect, because the global appearance blur is off — the overview effect gates on both ({cite}).
Animations feel {slower|faster} because the animation duration scale is currently set to {appearance.anim.durations.scale} — every duration token is multiplied by it, so lower means faster ({cite}).
The ambient glow is configured ON but is currently hidden, because ambient glow only renders in dark mode — it gates on ambientColor && !light ({cite}).
The bar hides because bar persistence is currently off — a non-persistent bar dodges or auto-hides instead of staying put ({cite}).
Window dodging has no effect, because dodge mode requires a persistent bar — the dodge gate is dodgeWindows && persistent ({cite}).
The bar is not as small as asked: the effective bar scale is floored at 0.6 ({cite}); the configured value is {bar.scale}.
